india_trends.title: India's forex reserves fall $18.3 bn as RBI steps in to defend rupee
india_trends.summary: India’s foreign exchange reserves fell $18.34 billion to $747.56 billion in the week ended September 25, marking the third consecutive weekly decline. The reserves have dropped $38.15 billion in three weeks from their record high of $785.71 billion on September 4.
